== Summary ==
Slip “•Mara Jade With Lightsaber” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 1225, 1624, 1946)). Version [[Mara Jade With Lightsaber (Remastered 2025)|Mara Jade With Lightsaber (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Not a recreation.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-9/9c/V0-D-marajadewithlightsaber-2025-12-26-sheet-slip.png Internet Archive item].
